**EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT**

This Employment Agreement ("Agreement") is made on [DATE]  

**BETWEEN**  
[EMPLOYER NAME], a company incorporated under the laws of India, having its registered office at [EMPLOYER ADDRESS] (hereinafter referred to as the "Employer"),  

**AND**  
[EMPLOYEE NAME], residing at [EMPLOYEE ADDRESS], holding Aadhaar number [Aadhaar Number] (hereinafter referred to as the "Employee").  

The Employer and the Employee are collectively referred to as the "Parties" and individually as a "Party."

---

### 1. **APPOINTMENT**  
The Employer hereby appoints the Employee, and the Employee hereby accepts appointment, as a **Systems Developer** with effect from [START DATE]. This appointment shall be subject to the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement and as governed by applicable laws in force in the State of Karnataka and the Republic of India.

---

### 2. **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**  
The Employee shall perform the duties and responsibilities customary to the role of a Systems Developer, including but not limited to:  
- Designing, developing, testing, and maintaining software systems;  
- Collaborating with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features;  
- Troubleshooting, debugging, and upgrading existing systems;  
- Ensuring code quality, security, and performance standards;  
- Complying with internal development protocols and project timelines;  
- Performing any other duties as may be assigned by the Employer from time to time in relation to the Employee’s role.

The Employee shall perform such duties diligently, in good faith, and in the best interests of the Employer.

---

### 3. **WORKPLACE**  
The primary place of work for the Employee shall be the Employer’s office located at [OFFICE ADDRESS], Karnataka, India. The Employee shall work on-site unless otherwise permitted in writing by the Employer. The Employee may be required to travel within or outside Karnataka for official purposes as needed.

---

### 4. **SALARY AND COMPENSATION**  
The Employee shall receive a fixed annual salary of **INR 1,575,000 (Indian Rupees Fifteen Lakh Seventy-Five Thousand Only)**, payable in equal monthly installments in accordance with the Employer’s payroll schedule. This salary is exclusive of any statutory deductions required under applicable law.  

The Employee shall not be entitled to any additional compensation, bonuses, or benefits unless expressly provided for under a separate written policy or agreement approved by the Employer.

---

### 5. **PROBATION PERIOD**  
The Employee shall serve a probation period of **five (5) months** from the date of joining. During this period, the performance of the Employee shall be assessed by the Employer. The Employer reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to confirm, extend, or terminate the Employee’s services at any time during or at the end of the probation period, subject to applicable notice requirements and statutory protections.

---

### 6. **WORKING TIME**  
The normal working hours shall be **forty-two (42) hours per week**, scheduled from Monday to Saturday, unless otherwise specified by the Employer in compliance with applicable labor laws. The Employee may be required to work additional hours as necessary to meet project deadlines or operational requirements, subject to compliance with the provisions of the Karnataka Shops and Commercial Establishments Act, 1961, and other applicable laws.

---

### 7. **LEAVE ENTITLEMENTS**  
The Employee shall be entitled to leave in accordance with the Employer’s leave policies and applicable statutory provisions, including:  
- Earned leave as per applicable law;  
- Sick leave as permitted under company policy and law;  
- Casual leave and public holidays as declared by the Employer;  
- Maternity/paternity leave, if applicable, in accordance with the applicable statutes.  

All leave requests must be submitted in advance and approved by the Employer.

---

### 8. **STATUTORY BENEFITS**  
The Employee shall be entitled to statutory benefits as required under applicable Indian laws, including but not limited to:  
- Employees’ Provident Fund and Employees’ Pension Scheme under the Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952;  
- Employee State Insurance (ESI), if applicable;  
- Gratuity under the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972, upon completion of eligibility period;  
- Minimum wages and other protections under the Karnataka Shops and Commercial Establishments Act, 1961;  
- Any other benefits mandated by law from time to time.  

The Employer shall make all required statutory deductions and contributions in accordance with the law.

---

### 9. **CONFIDENTIALITY**  
The Employee shall not, during or after the term of employment, disclose, use, or permit the use of any confidential information, trade secrets, technical data, business strategies, client information, or proprietary systems of the Employer, except as required in the course of performing authorized duties. This obligation shall continue indefinitely after termination of employment, to the extent permitted by law.

---

### 10. **INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY**  
All intellectual property, including but not limited to software code, designs, documentation, inventions, and developments, created, conceived, or reduced to practice by the Employee during the course of employment and relating to the business or operations of the Employer, shall be the sole and exclusive property of the Employer. The Employee agrees to execute any documents and take any actions reasonably requested by the Employer to vest full ownership of such intellectual property in the Employer.

---

### 11. **WORKPLACE POLICIES**  
The Employee shall comply with all lawful workplace policies, codes of conduct, IT usage guidelines, and safety procedures issued by the Employer from time to time, including those relating to data protection, harassment, and ethical standards. Breach of such policies may lead to disciplinary action, up to and including termination.

---

### 12. **TERMINATION**  
Either Party may terminate this Agreement by providing **thirty (30) days** written notice to the other Party. During the notice period, the Employee shall continue to perform duties unless otherwise directed by the Employer. The Employer reserves the right to relieve the Employee from duties during the notice period without altering the terms of compensation until termination.  

Termination shall also be subject to applicable provisions of the Karnataka Shops and Commercial Establishments Act, 1961, and other relevant labor laws.

---

### 13. **DISPUTE RESOLUTION**  
Any dispute or difference arising out of or in connection with this Agreement shall be resolved amicably through mutual discussions. If unresolved, the dispute shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the competent courts in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India, in accordance with applicable laws.

---

### 14. **GENERAL PROVISIONS**  
- This Agreement constitutes the entire understanding between the Parties and supersedes all prior discussions or agreements.  
- Any amendment to this Agreement must be in writing and signed by both Parties.  
- The terms of this Agreement are subject to compliance with all applicable laws and regulations in India.  
- If any provision of this Agreement is held to be invalid or unenforceable, the remaining provisions shall remain in full force and effect.  

---

**IN WITNESS WHEREOF**, the Parties have executed this Agreement on the date first above written.
